question: A consultant works in a free Claude account and keeps a separate project for each client. She already has five projects and has just signed a sixth client whose material she wants to keep separate too. What should she do first?
options: A) Ask an administrator to raise the project allowance on her account before she starts the work.
B) Review her five projects and retire or repurpose one, since a free account is capped at five projects.
C) Create the sixth project as normal, since the cap on the number of projects applies only to shared ones.
D) Keep this client in ordinary chats instead, since projects are only offered on the paid plans.
correct_answers: B) Review her five projects and retire or repurpose one, since a free account is capped at five projects.
explanations: A personal free account has no administrator who can lift the cap; the plan defines the limit.
Correct. Projects are available to everyone, but a free account is limited to five of them, so she has to free one up before a sixth client workspace can exist.
The five-project cap on free accounts is not limited to shared projects; it covers her projects.
Projects are available to all users, including free accounts, so this misreads the constraint.
